facts: Official B3 page provides daily bulletins/files with retroactive date selection.

facts: Official BCB open-data PTAX dataset exposes API/OData/JSON and history since 1984.

limitations: Dataset page alone does not prove exact public-release timestamp field required for event-time PIT.
